history.summary: Split follows time spent and client-requested rework, with a small lift for Sora because the voice was re-done twice at client request.

reasons.text: Wrote the script and two revisions after client feedback (165 min total).
Client asked for a shorter intro and new ending; she delivered.
Most time: four edit cuts, color pass and export (265 min).
Reworked subtitles to one line and re-synced voiceover after client feedback.
Recorded the voiceover, the key required element of the brief.
Re-recorded the full voiceover twice for a warmer tone at client request.

disputes.text: Sora: my two re-recordings weren't counted
disputes.answer: Sora is partly right: e10 and e12 are two full client-requested re-recordings (36 min), and the voice drove the rework in e11 and e13. v1 already listed them, but I raised her share from 19% to 23%; her total time (76 min) is still well below Mina and Jun.

events.text: Project created with the demo production log (15 events).
Moonbrew Coffee opened PayPal checkout for $600.00.
AI (claude-sonnet-5-5) proposed split v1 from the production log.
Sora disputed v1: “Sora: my two re-recordings weren't counted”
AI (claude-sonnet-5-5) revised the split to v2. Approvals were reset.

proposal.summary: Split by time, client-requested rework and impact on the final video. Sora's two re-recordings are now weighted more as rework.

reasons.text: Wrote script v1 and two revisions (165 min).
Delivered the shorter intro and new ending the client asked for.
Most time: four cuts, color pass and export (265 min).
Fixed subtitles to one line and re-synced new voiceover after feedback.
Recorded the voiceover, a required part of the brief (40 min).
Re-recorded the full voiceover twice for a warmer tone at client request (36 min).

proposal.changedBecause: Sora is partly right: e10 and e12 are two full client-requested re-recordings (36 min), and the voice drove the rework in e11 and e13. v1 already listed them, but I raised her share from 19% to 23%; her total time (76 min) is still well below Mina and Jun.
